newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: UAE president meets Sudanese opposition leader.
newsitem.headline: UAE president meets Sudanese opposition leader.

text.p: United Arab Emirates President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan on Wednesday met visiting Sudanese opposition leader Mohammed Osman al-Mirghani, the official WAM news agency said.

Sheikh Zaid told al-Mirghani, chairman of the northern National Democratic Alliance, that the UAE supported Sudan's security, unity and integrity and hoped that its "internal differences would be resolved in a manner safeguarding the interests of the Sudanese people", the agency said.
Sheikh Zaid last week met Sudanese Cabinet Affairs Minister Salah-Eddin Mohammad Ahmed Karrar and told him the UAE was ready to mediate in the conflict in Sudan.

A coalition of northern and southern opposition forces have been fighting Sudanese army units along the country's eastern border. Sudan has accused Eritrea and Ethiopia of backing the rebels. Both countries and the rebels have denied the charge.
